about.title: About me
about.imageAlt: RAYDEN at a multi-monitor workstation, building a game world
about.lead:
RAYDEN — Creator of Virtual Worlds
I create worlds, games, characters, stories and experiences from a blank canvas on the screen, starting in an empty universe and shaping every element with purpose.
Immersed in the process, I lean on the support of a community of players and other creators. Together we experience the worlds as they evolve in a never ending cycle.
The road IS the destination.
